rca_of_issue: Frontend UI Testing Blocked - Root Cause: Ngrok tunnel service experiencing persistent connection failures. Error: 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading body)'. Expo logs show continuous tunnel restart attempts. This is a known ngrok infrastructure issue affecting the preview environment. The application code is correct and previous iteration confirmed UI works when tunnel is stable. Mitigation: Wait for ngrok service recovery or use alternative tunneling solution for preview environments.
